WorkflowActivationError now sets level 'warning' when its cause carries failure.cause === 'credential-invalid', so activation errors for credentials that need reconnecting are no longer reported as errors. Added two tests.

### What changed
- `packages/workflow/src/errors/workflow-activation.error.ts`
- `packages/workflow/test/errors/workflow-activation.error.test.ts`

### What ran
- The agent ran tests 1 time(s): acdc-test on workflow-activation.error.test.ts: 12 passed. acdc-typecheck: 0 errors. acdc-lint on the two changed files: 0 warnings, 0 errors.
- After the agent, the executor ran: tests fail, type check passes, lint passes
- **The agent said the tests pass; the executor's run says they do not.**

### Risks that remain
- Change risk: medium (9% chance of a revert or follow-up fix, from n8n's history)
- Assumes 'warning' level is what suppresses reporting downstream (packages outside packages/workflow aren't present to confirm)
- The check reads `failure` from the original cause. A cause that is not an ExecutionBaseError and has an unrelated `failure` property would be read the same way
- The check duck-types `failure` instead of using a typed accessor, to avoid coupling to a specific error class

- category bugfix: at most agent_reviewed

runs.evidence:
Closes N8N-42923

Native evaluation (and verify sampling) is now skipped for workflows containing Function or Function Item (vm2 sandbox) nodes. WorkflowExpression detects such nodes and passes skipNativeEvaluation to Expression.resolveSimpleParameterValue, so those expressions use the regular pipeline. Added a test for both node types.

### What changed
- `packages/workflow/src/expression.ts`
- `packages/workflow/src/workflow-expression.ts`
- `packages/workflow/test/native-evaluation-metrics.test.ts`

### What ran
- The agent ran tests 1 time(s): acdc-test test/native-evaluation-metrics.test.ts passed (2 files, 32 tests). acdc-typecheck and acdc-lint on the changed files showed 0 errors and 0 warnings. I did not run the rest of the package's tests.
- After the agent, the executor ran: tests fail, type check passes, lint passes
- **The agent said the tests pass; the executor's run says they do not.**

### Risks that remain
- Change risk: medium (21% chance of a revert or follow-up fix, from n8n's history)
- Which node types count as vm2 sandbox nodes is my assumption: Function and Function Item only. Code node is excluded.
- The node scan runs on every expression resolution. It is O(nodes) per call and not cached; add caching if profiling shows a cost on large workflows.
- Expression.resolveSimpleParameterValue gained a new optional trailing parameter.

- category bugfix: at most agent_reviewed
